Name: Measure Filter
Expression:
VAR MinValue = MIN('Percentage Filter'[Value])
VAR MaxValue = MAX('Percentage Filter'[Value])
VAR CurrentMeasureValue = [Margin Value %]
RETURN
IF(
    CurrentMeasureValue >= MinValue && CurrentMeasureValue <= MaxValue,
    1,
    0
)

Name: Margin Color Code
Expression:
SWITCH(
    TRUE(),
    [Margin Value %] < 0, 1,    -- Red
    [Margin Value %] >= 0 && [Margin Value %] < 0.05, 2,    -- Pink
    [Margin Value %] >= 0.05 && [Margin Value %] < 0.10, 3,   -- Orange
    [Margin Value %] >= 0.10 && [Margin Value %] <= 0.1499, 4,  -- Yellow
    BLANK()
)

Name: Net Margin $ Discrepancy
Expression: [Sum of Positive Margin $ Discrepancy] + [Sum of Negative Margin $ Discrepancy]

Name: Measure Filter 2
Expression:
VAR MinValue = MIN('Percentage Filter'[Value])
VAR MaxValue = MAX('Percentage Filter'[Value])
VAR CurrentMeasureValue = [Actual Margin %]
RETURN
IF(
    CurrentMeasureValue >= MinValue && CurrentMeasureValue <= MaxValue,
    1,
    0
)

Name: Margin % Color Code
Expression:
SWITCH(
    TRUE(),
    [Actual Margin %] >= .39999, 1,  // Dark Green
    [Actual Margin %] >= 0.305 && [Actual Margin %] <= 0.4, 3,  // Green
    [Actual Margin %] = .3 && [Actual Margin %] = 0.30, 2,  // White
    [Actual Margin %] >= 0.199 && [Actual Margin %] < 0.299, 4,  // Yellow
    [Actual Margin %] >= 0.099 && [Actual Margin %] < 0.199, 5,  // Orange
    [Actual Margin %] >= 0 && [Actual Margin %] < 0.099, 6,  // Red
    [Actual Margin %] <= 0, 7,  // Dark Red
    BLANK()
)

Name: Margin $ Discrepancy Color Code
Expression:
SWITCH(
    TRUE(),
    [Margin $ Discrepancy] > 1, 1,  // Dark Green
    [Margin $ Discrepancy] >= 0.75 && [Margin $ Discrepancy] <= 1, 2,  // Green
    [Margin $ Discrepancy] >= 0.50 && [Margin $ Discrepancy] < 0.75, 3,  // Light Green
    [Margin $ Discrepancy] >= 0.25 && [Margin $ Discrepancy] < 0.50, 4,  // Lighter Green
    [Margin $ Discrepancy] > 0 && [Margin $ Discrepancy] < 0.25, 5,  // Even Lighter Green
    [Margin $ Discrepancy] = 0, 6,  // White
    [Margin $ Discrepancy] < 0 && [Margin $ Discrepancy] >= -0.25, 7,  // Real Light Red
    [Margin $ Discrepancy] < -0.25 && [Margin $ Discrepancy] >= -0.50, 8,  // Lighter Red
    [Margin $ Discrepancy] < -0.50 && [Margin $ Discrepancy] >= -0.75, 9,  // Light Red
    [Margin $ Discrepancy] < -0.75 && [Margin $ Discrepancy] >= -1, 10,  // Red
    [Margin $ Discrepancy] < -1, 11,  // Dark Red
    BLANK()
)

Name: Total SOH Qty
Expression: SUM('Parts_Low_Margin_jdis_InMaster'[Bulk Bin Qty]) + SUM('Parts_Low_Margin_jdis_InMaster'[On Hand Qty])

Name: % Difference
Expression:
DIVIDE(
    ([Original MDP Value] - [Inventory Cost]), 
    ([Original MDP Value] + [Inventory Cost]) / 2, 
    0
)

Name: Measure Filter 3
Expression:
VAR MinValue = MIN('Percentage Filter'[Value])
VAR MaxValue = MAX('Percentage Filter'[Value])
VAR CurrentMeasureValue = [% Difference]
RETURN
IF(
    CurrentMeasureValue >= MinValue && CurrentMeasureValue <= MaxValue,
    1,
    0
)

Name: % Diff Discr (Low) Color Code
Expression:
SWITCH(
    TRUE(),
    [% Difference] >= 0, 1,  // Green gradient for > 0%
    [% Difference] <= -.000001 && [% Difference] > -0.05, 2,  // Light yellow for -0.1% through -5%
    [% Difference] <= -0.051 && [% Difference] > -0.1, 3,  // Light yellow for -0.1% through -5%
    [% Difference] <= -5 && [% Difference] > -10, 8,  // Light orange for -5.1% through -10%
    [% Difference] <= -.10, 4,  // Red gradient for -10.1% and lower
    BLANK()
)

Name: Original Margin $
Expression:
CALCULATE(
    SUMX(
        'InTrans_Low_Margin',
        ([List Price Manuf] - [Stock Order Price]) * [Qty]
    ),
    'InTrans_Low_Margin'[TYPE] = "I"
)
